about_the_game:
Rift Shaper is a VR roguelite where you shape the battlefield itself with your own hands. Raise pillars, break walls, and hurl boulders in intense melee battles that test skill and stamina. Punch, throw, and crush stone creatures using gesture-based combat and feel the true power of controlling the earth itself.

Geokinetic Combat

Bring out the power of the earth with your own movement. Each ability is triggered by striking precise stances inspired by real-life combat. Equip stone-forged gauntlets to crush, grab, and hurl your enemies directly. Intense battles with adjustable difficulty will let you break a sweat, move with purpose, and feel the adrenaline of every strike.

Shape the Rift

The ground itself is bursting alive with energy waiting to be unleashed. Use it to raise stalagmites and block attacks, pull walls to use as shields, or smash through them to create new or uncover hidden paths.

Unique Enemies

The same energy brought living stone creatures born from the ruins and the Rift itself. Some are as big as buildings themselves that shake the ground beneath you, others are almost just pebbles darting through the ground. Their rocky bodies can be grabbed, pushed, or torn apart piece by piece, letting you turn their strength against them.

Roguelite Progression

The Rift is volatile and constantly reshapes. Discover new geokinetic powers, upgrade your abilities, and experiment with different combat styles. No two battles will be the same, with a myriad of different rooms, enemies, and modifiers in multiple biomes.

Trapped in the Rift

You came as an explorer looking for the power of an almost-mythical city, but when a sudden collapse traps you inside, strange forces awaken within your body, powers that bound you to the very stone around you. Escaping is a deadly task, but every time you fall, you awaken back at your camp, forced to venture again into the ever-shifting ruins to uncover their secrets and find a way home.

Exploration

Beyond combat lies discovery. Collect samples from the Rift: flora, fauna, artifacts, and enemies to expand your personal journal on every expedition. Each entry reveals more about the Rift, its inhabitants, and about the power now flowing through you.

Side Quests

You may encounter others throughout the Rift, trapped as you or searching for their own answers. Help them recover what they've lost, clear blocked passages, or locate rare materials. This may take multiple expeditions and can reward you with unique loot, upgrades, or story insights.

Key Features

  • Pose-based abilities: Trigger geokinetic powers through intentional stances and gestures. Your body is the controller.

  • Destructible environments:  Raise, break, and reshape the terrain in real time.

  • Living stone creatures: Interact with enemies physically, pushing, pulling, or tearing them apart.

  • Roguelite mechanics: Unlock new powers, modifiers, and upgrades across runs.

  • Exploration: Gather samples and artifacts to uncover the mysteries of the Rift, and your place in relation to it.

  • Optional side quests: Assist stranded explorers and the inhabitants of the Rift.

Join the Community and help shape the Rift!

Share your ideas for new powers, enemies, and mechanics, report bugs, or discuss strategies with other explorers. Your feedback will directly influence development as the Rift continues to grow.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 6700 or greater
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • VR Support: VR supported but not mandatory
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i5-4590 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or greater
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: Open XR with motion controllers
